title: AuditEvent
description: v4 immutable audit event with SHA-256 hash chain. Aligned with audit_log DDL.

action.description: Unified action (replaces v3 event_type + action). E.g. rule_approved, row_quarantined, schema_updated

actor.description: Who performed the action (e.g. ProfilerAgent, DiagnosisAgent, human:admin)

details.description: Flexible JSON blob for action-specific context (replaces v3 before/after)

previous_event_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the previous audit event (null for first event)

event_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of this event — forms immutability chain
